exercises.sentence: _____ acordado en el acuerdo climático obliga a ampliar la fiscalización ambiental.
exercises.english: What was agreed in the climate agreement requires expanding environmental oversight.

exercises.sentence: Lo prioritario de la economía circular es aprovechar mejor los materiales y mejorar la sostenibilidad.
options: The priority of the circular economy is to make better use of materials and improve sustainability.
The priority of the circular economy is to lower the price of materials and improve sustainability.
The priority of the climate agreement is to make better use of materials and improve sustainability.

exercises.sentence: Sin una _____ independiente, las metas del acuerdo climático resultan difíciles de cumplir.
exercises.english: Without independent oversight, the goals of the climate agreement are hard to meet.

exercises.question: According to the policy report, what bottleneck threatens the pace of the energy transition?
options: Modernising the electricity grid so it can support growing electrification across sectors.
Eliminating all public transport projects in order to keep municipal electricity prices low.
Replacing energy-efficiency standards in buildings with voluntary agreements among private firms.

exercises.question: Why does the report recommend pairing a carbon tax with social compensation?
options: To prevent lower-income households from bearing an unfair burden while discouraging fossil-fuel use.
To allow heavy industries to keep their current emissions quotas without investing in clean technology.
To fund new highway construction in areas affected by water scarcity and desertification.

exercises.question: What does the report identify as the most urgent governance priority at the end?
options: Expanding commercial logging permits to finance short-term ecological-restoration projects.
Strengthening independent oversight, stable local-resilience budgets and clear rules for real action.
Postponing wetland conservation until regional water-management plans are drafted in the next decade.

template.prompt: Using 'lo previsto' (neuter lo + past participle), write one sentence saying that what is planned (lo previsto) in the climate agreement (en el acuerdo climático) strengthens resilience (fortalece la resiliencia).
template.answer: Lo previsto en el acuerdo climático fortalece la resiliencia.
